summary: Immutable records (round-<time>-<id>.<digest>.json, resolutions/ and remaps/ alike). accept-0001 retried after the reviewer reopened h1 counts once, at its first acceptance, so h1 stays open. r-v2-0002 holds the same request bytes accepted for Ana and for Ben: a conflict, since a stored operation belongs to the reviewer stamped on it. A per-entry remap moves hold to hnew. r-v2-0004 was edited after it was named: altered, still assembled, review incomplete. The CLI's v1 reader shows h1 resolved and the third risk at hold.
